mapper.sql: id, agent_id, chat_session_id, memory_key, memory_value, category, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM long_term_memory WHERE agent_id = CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid) ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO long_term_memory (agent_id, chat_session_id, memory_key, memory_value, category, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid), #{chatSessionId}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{category}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (agent_id, memory_key) DO UPDATE SET memory_value = EXCLUDED.memory_value, chat_session_id = EXCLUDED.chat_session_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM long_term_memory WHERE agent_id = CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
